{
  "verdict": "fix",
  "issues": [
    "No authentication or authorization specified, making the API insecure by default and unsuitable for any real-world deployment without immediate add-ons.",
    "No pagination, filtering, or sorting capabilities, which could cause performance degradation and poor user experience with large datasets.",
    "No API versioning strategy, risking breaking changes for future clients.",
    "No validation details for input data (e.g., required fields, data types, length limits), which could lead to inconsistent or corrupted state.",
    "No rate limiting or throttling, leaving the API vulnerable to abuse or DoS attacks."
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Add basic authentication (e.g., API keys or JWT) and role-based access control to secure endpoints.",
    "Implement query parameters for pagination (page, limit), filtering (status, title), and sorting (created_at, order).",
    "Introduce API versioning via URL path (e.g., /v1/tasks) or header to allow safe evolution.",
    "Define explicit validation rules for task fields (e.g., title required, max length, status enum) and return clear error messages for invalid inputs.",
    "Include rate limiting headers (e.g., X-RateLimit-*) to manage request quotas."
  ]
}
